# 150.00 arriving as two settling splits and a residue.
#
# Bank +150.00 against receivable splits of −60.00, −40.00 and −50.00. The
# first two settle a 100.00 invoice between them — one payment made of two
# splits — and the 50.00 is left over.
#
# The shape asks what the export does with a grouped settlement that also left
# a residue: `settlements_by_transaction` ungroups on a residue, so that a
# `prepayment:` can sit beside each block — but the residue belongs to the
# payment once, and computed per block it is written once per block.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction with four splits, three of them
# on the receivable and none in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-14 * "Money in, two lines and a residue"

	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 150.00 USD
		guid: "5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293041"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -60.00 USD
		guid: "6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f6071829304152"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
